purpose: Verify visitor pre-registration creates request with all mandatory attributes
preconditions: Visitor and designated host user exist in identity system; phone and ID are unblacklisted
action_or_input: Submit visit pre-registration with valid name, phone, email, Aadhaar ID, purpose, and valid time window
expected_result: VisitRequest created with status SUBMITTED, host notified, and unique request ID returned

purpose: Verify pre-registration is blocked immediately when phone or ID matches BlacklistRegistry
preconditions: BlacklistRegistry contains active entry for phone '9999999999' or ID 'BL-12345'
action_or_input: Attempt pre-registration submission using blacklisted phone or ID document number
expected_result: Submission refused with 400 Bad Request, reason cites blacklist restriction, no VisitRequest created

source_id: VMS-AFR-013-01 host approval and pass issuance
purpose: Verify host APPROVE decision generates an active VisitorPass with cryptographic QR hash
preconditions: VisitRequest exists in SUBMITTED status assigned to faculty host
action_or_input: Host submits decision APPROVE with permitted zones ['ACADEMIC_BLOCK', 'LIBRARY']
expected_result: VisitRequest transitions to APPROVED; VisitorPass issued in ACTIVE status with valid_from/valid_to and unique pass_number

purpose: Verify security officer scanning active pass checks in visitor and creates VisitSession
preconditions: VisitorPass is ACTIVE, current timestamp is within [valid_from, valid_to], gate is in permitted_zones
action_or_input: Gate officer scans pass_number at Main Gate terminal
expected_result: Pass status remains ACTIVE, VisitSession created in ACTIVE status with check_in_time and gate officer user_id

purpose: Verify gate security check-out records departure and closes active visit session
preconditions: Active VisitSession exists for the visitor pass
action_or_input: Gate officer records departure at Main Gate exit terminal
expected_result: VisitSession status transitions to COMPLETED with check_out_time and exit gate logged; VisitorPass transitions to COMPLETED
